messages:
Aisha: hey team — heads up I'm taking PTO for a family thing on Mon 12/28 and need someone to cover EU night shift (00:00-08:00 UTC). It’s short notice, sorry. Can someone pick up the shadow handoff + watch for model regressions?
Jonah: I can take the first half (00:00-04:00 UTC) if that helps. Not available after 04:00.
Priya: I can do 04:00-08:00 UTC. @jonah want to do a quick handoff doc sync?
Aisha: @jonah @Priya thanks — plan: I'll leave a compact handoff and prewarm steps. Main risks: large-ctx requests spiking KV cache misses, and a canary deployment scheduled Sun night that may change routing.
Aisha: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-eu-night (see sections "prewarm" and "model-fallback")
Aisha: quick prewarm steps:
```
# prewarm kv cache + small-batch tokens
curl -X POST https://internal.api/redwood/warmup \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-quant","sequence_samples":5,"warmup_type":"kv-prefix"}'
# confirm batcher queues: source infra-> /metrics/batcher_active
```
Jonah: pinging infra: check batcher concurrency target set to 16 for that pool. If it's downscale to 8 we might see latency spikes.
Priya: noted. Also adding a short checklist for fallback policy: 1) if latency > 600ms for 5m, route to redwood-7b-quant-fp16 variant, 2) notify #eng-oncall and #eng-sre.
Matt: quick FYI — deploy-bot shows a nonbreaking canary at 23:45 UTC Sun. Might affect model routing briefly.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: infra/proxy-config v2.14 -> canary hosts eu-2 (23:45 UTC). Monitor proxy-errors >= 5/min.
SRE-oncall: please enable quiet-period rules for heavy batch jobs between 00:15-01:15 UTC if possible (we have a nightly DB snapshot).
Aisha: thanks — I'll update the handoff doc with the quiet-period note and the exact alert thresholds.
Jonah: I'll be online 23:50-04:10 UTC to shadow for the first 20 minutes then take the 00:00-04:00 block. Can we do a 10m huddle at 23:55 UTC?
Priya: 23:55 works for me. I'll join the handoff call for the last 5m before I start at 03:55 UTC.
Aisha: perfect — call: zoom.com/j/12345. TL;DR in handoff doc: active models, variant fallbacks, prewarm curl snippet, KV prefix warmup, batcher target, quiet-period, important alerts (#alerts/model-latency, #alerts/proxy-errors).
Matt: will add the proxy-errors alert dashboard link to the doc.
Priya: added a short test prompt set at the bottom of the runbook (5 quick queries) to validate correctness after warmup.
Aisha: leaving a token allocation note: try to avoid long experimental queries during 00:30-01:30 UTC. If you see high-cost tokens, throttle via per-route limits.
Jonah: got it. I'll post here if anything unusual shows up. :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks — enjoy PTO @Aisha :wave:
Aisha: much appreciated, will be reachable for 1hr before leaving for an emergency call. If something critical happens, ping me directly. :pray:
